subject: Proposal: Chery Tiggo Cross fleet solution for BCI Security
opening: Building on our existing business relationship, CMH Westrand would welcome the opportunity to support BCI Security's fleet requirements with a tailored Chery fleet solution. This proposal sets out how we would approach a fleet partnership, why the Chery Tiggo Cross may suit your operation, and a clear commercial framework to work from. It is a basis for discussion — the final package will be tailored to BCI's actual requirements, budget and replacement plans.

vehicle.imageCaption: Illustrative BCI Security livery concept on the Chery Tiggo Cross. Branding layout, roof signalling and graphics are shown for illustration and are subject to final design approval.
vehicle.wrapCaption: Livery concept across body views. Dimension callouts shown are an illustrative wrap-layout guide, not vehicle specifications.
vehicle.intro: The Chery Tiggo Cross is a modern compact SUV positioned for everyday practicality, driver comfort and running-cost efficiency. The figures below are published for the current South African range. The final specification — and whether the vehicle is the right fit — must be confirmed against BCI's operating requirements.

vehicle.suitability: The Tiggo Cross is proposed as a general-duty, everyday operational vehicle. It is not an armoured vehicle, a specialised patrol vehicle, or a vehicle for high-risk response, and should not be specified for those roles unless the relevant suitability has been independently confirmed. BCI's operating requirements must determine the final vehicle, derivative and any fitment.

commercial.brandingNote: CMH Westrand will contribute vehicle branding to the value of R6,500.00 per vehicle as part of this fleet proposal. This contribution is offered in good faith and is subject to final written agreement and branding design approval.
commercial.disclaimer: All pricing, finance structures, incentives and vehicle availability are subject to confirmation and the relevant approvals. Any discount, accessory package, service arrangement or other concession is subject to approval until authorised in writing. Finance is subject to affordability assessment, credit approval and lender terms. This document is a proposal for discussion and does not constitute a binding offer or a finance agreement.

support.d: A direct point of contact for vehicle enquiries and coordination.
Structured quotations based on the required number of vehicles and specifications.
Assistance exploring suitable finance structures, subject to affordability, credit approval and lender terms.
Assistance coordinating servicing and workshop bookings, subject to dealer capacity and agreed arrangements.
Optional accessories and vehicle branding, subject to quotation and approval.
Delivery coordination, subject to stock availability and agreed timelines.
An opportunity to discuss phased purchases and future replacement requirements.

supportNote: These are proposed support capabilities, offered in good faith — not contractual guarantees. Priority workshop treatment, courtesy or replacement vehicles, guaranteed uptime, special service rates and dedicated fleet-management resources are not implied by this document. Each can be explored and, if agreed, confirmed in writing.
optionsNote: These are starting points for discussion. BCI has not selected any option, and this proposal makes no claim of guaranteed savings. The right structure, and any commercial benefit, will be established together once BCI's requirements are confirmed.
nextStepsIntro: We would welcome the opportunity to understand BCI Security's fleet requirements and develop a commercial proposal aligned with your business. A short discussion would let us confirm your vehicle requirements, replacement plans, preferred acquisition structure and budget — after which CMH Westrand can prepare a detailed quotation for your consideration.
informationRequired: Intended vehicle use and operating environment
about: CMH Westrand is a dealership within the Combined Motor Holdings (CMH) Group and an authorised Chery dealer. Through CMH Westrand, BCI Security would have a single point of contact for new-vehicle supply, finance facilitation, servicing and aftersales support across its Chery fleet.
